reasoning: GNU Libtool’s HACKING §9.4 names the “Libtool exception clause” and supplies the header for the libtool script generated from ltmain.in. The clause permits a distributor to include the covered file under the same distribution terms used for the rest of the program when the file is distributed as part of a program or library built using GNU Libtool. The template names Free Software Foundation, Inc. in its copyright line and identifies the Free Software Foundation as publisher of the GPL. The index’s name, exception classification and active state are an editorial mapping of this documentary form.
